parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside in test-scoped file paths: two in 'Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift', one in 'Shared/Playback/Tests/RadioPlayerTests/RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift', and one in 'Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift'. Although the context flags do not explicitly set is_test=true or is_mock=true, the file paths unambiguously place every record inside test targets (Tests/ directories and a Mocks/ subdirectory). The cluster carries no fields_or_signature data and no structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor are all null), making it impossible to ground any actionable refactor recommendation. Consolidating test-local type aliases across package boundaries (Playback vs. PartyHorn) would couple unrelated test targets without clear benefit.
